title: don't go to any trouble
expression: You don't have to go to any trouble for me

sentences.en: So your father tells me you've been reading a new book?
sentences.ko: 아빠한테 들으니 새 책을 읽고 있다면서?

sentences.en: I am. It's about how to make friends.
sentences.ko: 맞아요. 친구 사귀는 법에 관한 책이에요.

sentences.en: Is that something you're interested in?
Not really, but Missy told me it makes you sad that I don't have any.
sentences.ko: 딱히요. 근데 미시가 그러는데 제가 친구 없는 게 엄마를 슬프게 한대요.

sentences.en: I got to sew that girl's mouth shut.
Well, the principles in the book didn't work for me at all.
sentences.ko: 음, 책에 나온 원칙들은 저한텐 전혀 안 통했어요.

sentences.en: Although Dad does like being called George over and over again, so you might give that a try.
sentences.ko: 아빠는 조지라고 계속 불러주는 걸 좋아하시더라고요. 엄마도 한번 해보세요.

sentences.en: Baby, you don't have to go to any trouble for me.
sentences.ko: 아가, 엄마 때문에 그렇게 애쓸 필요 없어.

sentences.en: But I like doing things for you. You're a nice lady.
sentences.ko: 근데 전 엄마를 위해 뭔가 하는 게 좋아요. 좋은 분이시잖아요.

sentences.en: But if the book's not working--
It isn't. But I realized if I find the other people who checked out the book, they'd be looking for friends, too.
sentences.ko: 없죠. 근데 그 책을 빌려 간 다른 사람들을 찾으면, 그 사람들도 친구를 찾고 있을 거라는 걸 깨달았어요.

sentences.en: I'm as surprised as you are.
